#   HAW-15 @ 65% FAILED (2026-07-12) — OSPREY'S FOUNDING CALIBRATION LESSON. "Ukraine does NOT strike Russian crude-export infrastructure by Jul 15" — resolved FAILED after a Will-directed correction of HAWK's own same-day CONFIRMED-lean (twice wrong same day). Root cause #1: a prediction's literal wording (named terminals: Primorsk/Ust-Luga/Novorossiysk/Druzhba) narrowed the evidence sweep — search the MECHANISM ("Ukraine attacking Russian oil" — refineries AND terminals AND tankers AND pipeline), not just the named literal targets. Root cause #2 (corollary): HAWK's own energy-strike ledger was stale (last-updated 6/20, and had silently missed the 5/23+6/8 Novorossiysk re-strikes) — don't trust your own ledger as a baseline without checking its swept-through mark + running a completeness pass first. A first-pass "no results" is a search-coverage statement, not a fact. Full lesson: LESSONS.md item 1 below; full post-mortem: AGENTS/HAWK/thesis/PREDICTIONS_ARCHIVE.md#hawk-15.
#   Cross-cutting (apply to any prediction OSPREY writes, per HAWK's frozen record):

#     HAW-07 VOIDED-vs-CONFIRMED discipline — conditional predictions whose premise fails get VOIDED, not CONFIRMED/FAILED; no right-for-wrong-reasons credit on a conditional that happens to land near a correct-looking outcome for unrelated reasons.
#     HAW-08/09 pre-registration — set an action-based resolution rubric BEFORE the evidence search, not after; a 2nd-independent-path check neutralizes contamination caveats.

#     Wording-identity (HAW-10/HAW-14 class) — when a prediction and a vector/promotion threshold describe the same event, write ONE canonical sentence and reference it from both places; on conflict, the registered PREDICTIONS.tsv text is canonical. Locus-clauses and catalyst-clauses on a broad-mechanism risk understate realized risk — write the mechanism, not one channel/trigger of it.
